name: Python
description: Modern Python with best-practice defaults: uv, pyproject.toml, ruff (lint + format), pytest, mypy, and an AGENTS.md contract. Flat layout (scripts at the repo root, no packaging) by default; --layout src for an installable src/ package.
agentsBuildAndTest: This project uses uv only: `uv sync` installs the locked environment and every tool runs through `uv run` (`uv run pytest`, `uv run ruff check .`). Add dependencies with `uv add` and commit `uv.lock`. Don't use pip or add `requirements*.txt` files.
